```{r Input Nonsmokers transcript density}
Grp1 <- c("/path_to_folder/all_Grp1_samples_transcript_Stats")

```

```{r read the non smoker file and create a matrix}
# Read each CSV into a list
data_list <- lapply(Grp1, function(f) {
  df <- read.csv(f, skip = 3, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$Sample <- basename(f)  
  df
})

#check gene order across all files

# Extract gene vectors
gene_lists <- lapply(data_list, function(df) df$Gene)

# Compare to the first file
first_genes <- gene_lists[[1]]
order_check <- sapply(gene_lists, function(g) all(g == first_genes))

#combine all files for Grp1

combined_grp1 <- do.call(rbind, data_list)

#add normalized density to the file
# Add Density_normalized column for each row
# Create a lookup table: sample name → full file path

file_lookup <- setNames(Grp1, basename(Grp1))

# Normalize counts using full path
combined_grp1$Density_normalized <- mapply(function(count, sample_name) {
  full_path <- file_lookup[[sample_name]]       # get the full path
  area <- as.numeric(sub(".*: ", "", readLines(full_path, n = 2)[2]))
  count / area
}, combined_grp1$Count, combined_grp1$Sample)

#let us add a group column
combined_grp1$Group <- "grp1" 

library(tidyr)

wide_combined_grp1 <- pivot_wider(
  combined_grp1,
  names_from = Sample,
  values_from = c(Count, `Density (µm^-2)`, Density_normalized)
)
```

```{r write the files}
write.csv(combined_grp1, "path_to folder/grp1_transcript_density.csv")
write.csv(combined_grp2, "path_to_folder/grp2_transcript_density.csv")
write.csv(combined_grp3, "path_to_folder/grp3_transcript_density.csv")

```

```{r combine all the groups}
#combine all the groups for comparison
all_combined <- rbind(combined_grp1, combined_grp2, combined_grp3)
```

```{r fold change calculation}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Step 1: Compute mean density per gene per group
avg_density <- all_combined %>%
  group_by(Gene, Group) %>%
  summarize(mean_density = mean(Density_normalized), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: Pivot to wide format
avg_density_wide <- avg_density %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = mean_density)

# Step 3: Compute fold change
avg_density_wide <- avg_density_wide %>%
  mutate(
    FC_Grp3_vs_Grp1 = Grp3 / Grp1,
    FC_Grp3_vs_Grp2 = Grp3 / Grp2,
    log2_FC_Grp3_vs_Grp1 = log2(FC_Grp3_vs_Grp1),
    log2_FC_Grp3_vs_Grp2 = log2(FC_Grp3_vs_Grp2)
  )

# Function to compute p-value for two groups
compute_p <- function(df, group1, group2) {
  # Subset only the two groups
  df_sub <- df[df$Group %in% c(group1, group2), ]
  
  # Check if both groups have at least 2 samples
  if(length(unique(df_sub$Group)) < 2) return(NA)
  
  t.test(Density_normalized ~ Group, data = df_sub)$p.value
}

p_values <- all_combined %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  group_map(~ tibble(
    Gene = .y$Gene,
    p_Grp3_vs_Grp1 = compute_p(.x, "Grp3", "Grp1"),
    p_Grp3_vs_Grp2 = compute_p(.x, "Grp3", "Grp2")
  )) %>%
  bind_rows()

```
```{r merge with fold change}
avg_density_wide <- avg_density_wide %>%
  left_join(p_values, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    FDR_Grp3_vs_Grp1 = p.adjust(p_Grp3_vs_Grp1, method = "BH"),
    FDR_Grp3_vs_Grp2 = p.adjust(p_Grp3_vs_Grp2, method = "BH")
  )

write.csv(avg_density_wide, "/path_to_folder/Fold_Change_All.csv")
```


```{r significant DEGs}
#filter out significantly up and downregulated genes
#since these are different regions of the lung, FDR does not make sense here
sig_up_Grp1 <- avg_density_wide %>% filter(log2_FC_Grp3_vs_Grp1 > 1)
sig_down_Grp1 <- avg_density_wide %>% filter(log2_FC_Grp3_vs_Grp1 < -1)

Grp3_vs_Grp1 <- rbind(sig_up_Grp1, sig_down_Grp1)

sig_up_Grp2 <- avg_density_wide %>% filter(log2_FC_Grp3_vs_Grp2 > 1)
sig_down_Grp2 <- avg_density_wide %>% filter(log2_FC_Grp3_vs_Grp2 < -1)

Grp3_vs_Grp2 <- rbind(sig_up_Grp2, sig_down_Grp2)

#identify statistical significance
#also wished to p-value to this equation

sig_up_Grp1 <- avg_density_wide %>% filter(log2_FC_Grp3_vs_Grp1 > 1 & p_Grp3_vs_Grp1 < 0.05)
sig_down_Grp1 <- avg_density_wide %>% filter(log2_FC_Grp3_vs_Grp1 < -1 & p_Grp3_vs_Grp1 < 0.05) 

sig_up_Grp2 <- avg_density_wide %>% filter(log2_FC_Grp3_vs_Grp2 > 1 & p_Grp3_vs_Grp2 < 0.05)
sig_down_Grp2 <- avg_density_wide %>% filter(log2_FC_Grp3_vs_Grp2 < -1 & p_Grp3_vs_Grp2 < 0.05)



```


```{r write the. results}
print(Grp3_vs_Grp1)
write.csv(Grp3_vs_Grp1, "/path_to_folder/Sig_DEGs_grp3_v_grp1.csv")

print(Grp3_vs_Grp2)
write.csv(Grp3_vs_Grp2, "/path_to_folder/Sig_DEGs_grp3_v_grp2.csv")

print(sig_up_Grp1)
write.csv(sig_up_Grp1, "/path_to_folder/Sig_DEGs_grp3_v_grp1_pvalue.csv")

print(sig_up_Grp2)
write.csv(sig_down_grp2, "/path_to_folder/Sig_DEGs_grp3_v_grp2_pvalue.csv")

```
